bull.point: The company maintains a robust capital structure with virtually no debt and high returns on capital.
Annual revenue growth remains consistent, reaching a record high in the most recent fiscal year.
bull.evidence: Revenue increased from ₹48,340 Cr in Mar 2019 to ₹78,868 Cr in Mar 2026

bull.point: The business demonstrates strong cash generation, converting a high percentage of profit into operating cash flow.
bull.evidence: 80% of reported profit turned into operating cash over 6 years

bear.point: Operating margins have seen a significant year-on-year decline in the most recent quarter.
bear.evidence: Latest-quarter margin 28% vs 34% a year ago

bear.point: Revenue growth has turned negative or slowed significantly in the three most recent quarters.
bear.evidence: YoY revenue growth of -5%, -11%, and 4% in the last three periods

bear.point: Working capital efficiency is deteriorating as the cash conversion cycle has lengthened over the last two years.
bear.evidence: Cash conversion cycle lengthened 16 days (148 to 164)

watch_next: Recovery of OPM from 28% toward historical 34-39% levels
Stabilization of YoY revenue growth after recent negative volatility
Improvement in cash conversion cycle below 164 days
